title: Raut urges Fadnavis to take part in 'Ram Raksha Andolan' of Sena (UBT) in Nagpur
description: Sena (UBT) head and former State CM Uddhav Thackeray had earlier said that he would take part in the Ram Raksha Andolan organised by the party in Nagpur, the hometown of CM Fadnavis, on Saturday (July 16).
